core_obligations: Quote the equivalence of conditions (1) and (2) from the cited lemma on factoring through projective modules (proof lines 17772-17774).
Show that (1) implies (3) by the vanishing of Ext^1 on projective modules (proof lines 17774-17778).
Show that (3) implies (1) by choosing a surjection from a projective module, using annihilation of the extension class and reading off the factorisation (proof lines 17778-17783).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the cited factoring lemma for (1) and (2) (proof lines 17772-17774).
(3) to (1) by the presentation and annihilation (proof lines 17778-17783).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects three equivalent descriptions of the near-projective modules of the section, and the proof is a 12-line argument that reduces the equivalence of the first two to a statement about factoring through projective versus free modules and then relates the factoring condition to the annihilation of Ext classes. The direction from factoring to annihilation is immediate from the projectivity of the middle module, while the converse chooses a surjection from a projective module, uses the annihilation of the extension class, and reads off the required factorisation; the two displayed implications are the content.
